steps.name: Phase 1: Any SAP OData API, contract-first, with a Tenant Twin
Phase 2: Postman before code, full OData writes, every language
Phase 3: Govern every connected program as code
Phase 4: Reach any SAP landscape, run anywhere
Phase 5: Every protocol and pattern on one pipeline

blockersToday.label: network SAP_SIDE_IP_ALLOWLIST
blockersToday.note: The hosted instance has no fixed egress address: no egress setting exists in the code, Vercel egress is dynamic unless Static IPs are bought [E47], and none is recorded for production (P4.4). SAP calls use the platform fetch with no proxy, tunnel or dispatcher (read.ts, write.ts; P4.1).

blockersToday.label: origin PARTNER
blockersToday.note: Partner-built services. Legacy reads send only $top and return at most 100 rows (read.ts); queries filter, select and page within the interface's query policy (P1.4). No partner service is recorded against a live tenant.

blockersToday.label: origin SAP_STANDARD
blockersToday.note: SAP-published APIs. Non-curated V4 paths are derived and read unverified until a probe of that exact path answers 200; wrapper rows have no address (hub-content.ts catalogueAddress; P0.8). Legacy reads send only $top and return at most 100 rows (read.ts); queries filter, select and page within the interface's query policy (P1.4).

blockersToday.label: origin CUSTOMER_CUSTOM
blockersToday.note: Customer-built services. Legacy reads send only $top and return at most 100 rows (read.ts); queries filter, select and page within the interface's query policy (P1.4). No Z* or YY1_* call is recorded against a live tenant.

blockersToday.label: network PRIVATE_NETWORK
blockersToday.note: Private hosts are refused: connection-url-guard.ts rejects IP literals, .local and .internal names. SAP calls use the platform fetch with no proxy, tunnel or dispatcher (read.ts, write.ts; P4.1).

blockersToday.label: targetTech BTP_SERVICE / REST

blockersToday.label: sapAuth BTP_SERVICE / API_KEY
blockersToday.note: API_KEY toward SAP. A header key works (api-key-header.ts) but cannot be combined with OAuth, which Ariba needs (connection-resolver.ts).

blockersToday.label: sapAuth BTP_SERVICE / OAUTH_SAML_BEARER
blockersToday.note: OAUTH_SAML_BEARER toward SAP. The assertion is built for SuccessFactors (saml-assertion.ts) and has not been proven against a live tenant (P0.9).

blockersToday.label: sapAuth BTP_SERVICE / PRINCIPAL_PROPAGATION
blockersToday.note: Every call runs as the connection's one stored user; no end-user identity reaches SAP (connection-resolver.ts SapAuthType has no such type).

blockersToday.label: sapAuth BTP_SERVICE / X509_MTLS
blockersToday.note: No client-certificate auth type (connection-resolver.ts SapAuthType: basic, bearer, oauth-client-credentials, oauth-saml-bearer, api-key).

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_CLOUD / MTLS
blockersToday.note: No client-certificate handling on the northbound routes (auth.ts).

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_CLOUD / OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS
blockersToday.note: No northbound token endpoint (P2.5): the broker accepts a static bearer key only (auth.ts).

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_CLOUD / STATIC_BEARER
blockersToday.note: Static bearer key. Whether a communication arrangement can store a static header is unconfirmed; no ABAP sample.

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_CLOUD / USER_DELEGATED_OIDC
blockersToday.note: No user-delegated login on the northbound routes (auth.ts); console sign-in is a magic link or passkey.

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_ONPREM / MTLS
blockersToday.note: No client-certificate handling on the northbound routes (auth.ts).

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_ONPREM / OAUTH_CLIENT_CREDENTIALS
blockersToday.note: No northbound token endpoint (P2.5): the broker accepts a static bearer key only (auth.ts).

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_ONPREM / STATIC_BEARER
blockersToday.note: Static bearer key. SM59 stores no static header, so the header is set in code; no ABAP sample.

blockersToday.label: consumerAuth ABAP_ONPREM / USER_DELEGATED_OIDC
blockersToday.note: No user-delegated login on the northbound routes (auth.ts); console sign-in is a magic link or passkey.

lifecycle.meaning: Find which APIs exist and which work on *this* system
Define the contract, the fields and the mapping
Try and test an API before writing a program
Typed client in the developer's language
Checks in the developer's commit and CI pipeline
Move DEV to TEST to PROD with evidence
Watch, trace and alert the right people
Know what an SAP release breaks before it breaks
AI help that is checked against real runs
Build a Z*/YY1_* service, verify it per environment, transport it
CoreEdge's own contract with consumers: versions, deprecation, changelog
